title: Feed template
role: Anyone building a launcher app on feeds: a list of ids, or a result keyed by date
saves: Fetching one request per id, filling date ranges into a path and flattening a feed keyed by date by hand
summary: Top stories fetched by id and close asteroid approaches grouped by day, from public APIs. Runs on sample data; shows hydrate, date tokens, flatten, id_field and parent_field.
